other_conditions: Must have secured merit in Punjabi subject in the 8th or 10th class examinations conducted by Haryana Board of School Education, Bhiwani.
Must continue studying Punjabi subject in the 9th and 11th classes.
Scholarship renewal depends on satisfactory performance in subsequent classes.
Selection is automatic based on school records; no separate application required.
benefits_summary: Monthly scholarships of ₹50 for classes IX–X and ₹75 for classes XI–XII, directly transferred to students' bank accounts.
